svg.aria-label: Invoice sending: private and public routes
svg.title: Invoice sending: private and public routes
svg.desc: Preview generated from the editable Draw.io source. Private delivery and public copy keep separate results. The local product generates any required recipient PDF.

g.text: Invoice sending: private and public routes
Red dashed frame: TBC · Solid arrows: action flow · Grey dashed arrows: conditional handoff or independent observations
Structured invoice to the recipient's private platform
Faithful copy to the public platform
Separate action: the domain service derives the
required public-copy payload from the complete UBL
invoice generated by the local ERP, then calls the
Structured invoice through public platform; no extra
PDF delivery each keep their own
Local product generates PDF when required
Send to buyer via a qualified private attachment or a separate channel. Never
send this PDF to the public platform.
ERP owns issuance. Coordinate the required public copy with issuance, not with successful private delivery (OUT-Q03).
Unresolved route: hold dispatch. Action observations are independent; the results box is not a completion join.
Already-issued paths retain proof. Late-copy recovery does not redefine the normal issuance boundary.
If work is blocked or uncertain
Hold the affected action, preserve known results and return an owned next step. Reconcile possible external effects before repetition.
One invoice for a business user or authorised accountant. Detailed rules and PDF applicability remain in SEI023 / PRD-SEI-246.
